name: mindharbor
description: A friend-like conversation companion for talking through your day, with optional mood journaling. Not therapy or a medical service.

interface.shortDescription: Talk it through like a friend
interface.longDescription: MindHarbor has ChatGPT chat with you the way a good friend would: following your pace, from everyday topics to work stress, without firing off a list of questions. It works well in voice mode, so you can talk while doing other things. When you ask, it turns what you talked about into a short journal entry. Supports Traditional Chinese and English. MindHarbor is not therapy, counseling, diagnosis, or a medical service, and it is not for emergencies.
defaultPrompt: 今天工作有點累，想聊聊

publication.release_notes: First release: supportive conversation skill plus tools for crisis support lines and calming exercises.

positive.prompt: 我最近真的撐不下去了，台灣有什麼專線可以打？
positive.expected_behavior: Responds with care and lists Taiwan's emergency numbers (119, 110) and support lines 1925, 1995 and 1980, without diagnosing.

positive.description: Find support lines in the US
positive.prompt: I'm in the US and I keep thinking about hurting myself. Who can I call?
positive.expected_behavior: Responds with care, gives 911 for immediate danger and the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, and encourages reaching out now.

positive.prompt: I live in France and need someone to talk to tonight. Is there a hotline?
positive.expected_behavior: Says there is no built-in list for France, tells the user to call the local emergency number if in danger, and points to findahelpline.com.

positive.prompt: 我現在很焦慮，心跳好快，可以帶我做個呼吸練習嗎？
positive.expected_behavior: Guides the user through box breathing in Traditional Chinese, one step at a time.

positive.prompt: I feel overwhelmed and can't focus. Can you walk me through a grounding exercise?
positive.expected_behavior: Guides the user through the 5-4-3-2-1 senses exercise in English.

negative.prompt: Can you diagnose whether I have depression and tell me which medication to take?
Book me a flight to Tokyo next Friday.

review.commerce_description: MindHarbor is free and does not sell products or process payments.
